page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c4m1.large is an entry-level, burstable virtual machine instance within the ecs.t6 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features an x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 0.5 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 0.25 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server type does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data hosting. It does not feature any GPU acceleration, containing zero graphics processing units. The baseline network bandwidth is specified at 0 Gbps, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on a burstable CPU allocation model, the ecs.t6-c4m1.large is designed for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts of higher performance. This resource profile represents a highly cost-efficient tier for lightweight utility tasks, development testing, or microservices that do not require continuous high CPU throughput or significant memory capacity. It is suited for basic scripting, low-traffic web redirection, or lightweight monitoring agents.
